Convert kilonewtons and kilopascals into newtons and pascals.

engage.title: WHICH SHOE?
engage.hook: Someone steps on your hand. Would you rather they wore a stiletto heel or a trainer? Why?

reveal.question: Same person, same weight. So what is different?
reveal.answer: The area. The trainer spreads the force over a big area, so the pressure on your hand is small. The stiletto puts it all on a tiny area: huge pressure.

learn.heading: Calculating pressure
learn.example: Pressure is the force acting on each square metre. A 600 N person standing on 0.04 m^2 of feet: p = 600 ÷ 0.04 = 15 000 Pa.

items: stiletto heel · sharp knife · drawing pin point · nail tip
The force is squashed onto a tiny area, so it pushes in or cuts.
snowshoes · camel feet · tractor tyres · wide bag straps
The force is spread over a big area, so it does not sink in or dig in.

build.q: Which equation is used to calculate pressure?
build.explanation: Pressure is the force on each unit of area, so divide the force by the area.

build.q: Which is a unit of pressure?
build.explanation: Pressure is measured in pascals; 1 Pa = 1 N/m^2.
build.commonError: Choosing newtons, the unit of force.

build.q: A force of 20 N acts on an area of 4 m^2. What is the pressure?
build.commonError: 80 Pa comes from multiplying; 0.2 Pa from dividing the wrong way round.

build.q: Why does a sharp knife cut better than a blunt one?
options: A. The edge has a larger area, so the pressure is greater.
B. The edge has a smaller area, so the pressure is greater.
C. The edge has a larger area, so the pressure is smaller.
D. The edge has a smaller area, so the pressure is smaller.
build.explanation: Same force on a smaller area gives a bigger pressure.
build.commonError: Thinking a bigger area gives a bigger pressure.

build.q: Snowshoes stop you sinking into deep snow. Why?
options: B. They spread your weight over a bigger area, so the pressure is lower.
C. They make the area smaller, so the pressure is higher.
D. They reduce the force of gravity on you.
build.explanation: Your weight (the force) stays the same; the bigger area lowers the pressure on the snow.

worked.prompt: A box weighs 200 N. It rests on an area of 0.5 m^2. Calculate the pressure.
steps: Write the equation: p = F ÷ A

yourTurn.prompt: A crate weighs 900 N. It rests on an area of 1.5 m^2. Calculate the pressure.

statements.text: A heavier object always puts more pressure on the ground.
statements.correction: Pressure also depends on area. An elephant's big feet can press less than a stiletto heel.
Pressure is measured in pascals (Pa) or N/m^2. Newtons measure force.

statements.text: If the force stays the same and the area halves, the pressure doubles.

developing.a: The wide feet give a large area, which spreads the camel's weight, so the pressure on the sand is lower.

reaching.q: A student weighing 600 N stands on one foot. The area of the foot is 0.02 m^2. Calculate the pressure.
A force of 4 kN acts on an area of 2 m^2. Calculate the pressure in pascals.
A drawing pin has a sharp point and a wide, flat head. Explain why it is designed like this.
reaching.a: The point has a tiny area, so the pressure is high and it goes into the board. The head has a large area, so the pressure on your thumb is low and it does not hurt.

mastering.q: A pressure of 2500 Pa acts on an area of 0.4 m^2. Calculate the force.

An elephant weighs 50 000 N and stands on four feet, each with an area of 0.1 m^2. A woman weighs 600 N and stands on one stiletto heel with an area of 0.0001 m^2. Who puts more pressure on the floor? Show your working.
mastering.a: Elephant: area = 4 × 0.1 = 0.4 m^2; p = 50 000 ÷ 0.4 = 125 000 Pa. Woman: p = 600 ÷ 0.0001 = 6 000 000 Pa. The woman's heel puts more pressure on the floor.

mastering.q: A pressure of 15 kPa acts on an area of 3 m^2. Calculate the force in newtons.
